svg.aria-label: Timeline. 2021: MERN apps and realtime chat. 2023: Docker, logging and hardening Node services. 2024: Next.js, access and refresh tokens, RTK Query. 2025: Kafka, Kubernetes, FastAPI and MCP servers. 2026: LangGraph, RAG, and Stayzy goes live in July.
